source_transfer: A8 max includes color and depth/stencil vk.layer_count, then raw dword count; A6/A7 retain old count-1

risk: Hardware interpretation/2048 edge and why native differs are unproved. Native experiment restoration only, not an established generic correctness fix or performance gain.

Nonzero baseArrayLayer, remaining layers and 2D array views of3D images
